repositories.review_note: Graph invariants and selector planning; cancelled selector can retain partial working copy. Do not publish partial authority.
Content store, view latch, turn integrity and range/pair fixtures. Hashes identify content, not authority or stable event identity.
Capture finalization, indexing and bounded selection. Capture after truncation cannot prove native-byte fidelity.
Operation-key fingerprints, scoped FTS projection and observation versions. Verify ordinary write visibility without rebuilding; do not infer global ownership from IDs.
Generation drift, folding/tool linkage, scheduling and canonical prefix. JS scheduling and cache hints are not host authorization.
Decay, scheduling, historian validation and verification gates. Heuristics or model verification cannot prove source fidelity or authorize deletion.
Commit queue, generation/storage, safe prefix, async buffering and TTL fixtures. Process queue/timestamp/TTL alone cannot establish cross-process publication fencing.
Request rewriting and tool ordering. Do not canonicalize signed bytes or change tool semantics for cache hits.
Request capture and attribution fixtures. Preserve stored versus actual attempt distinction and unknown attribution; no full raw receipt by default.
Peek helper delegation. Caller-provided scope/tool hints cannot prove delegated authorization.
Correction detector and learning handler. Heuristic correction is a candidate, not user authority.
Background extraction and mem0 prefetch; cancellation of a caller is not proof remote work stopped. This fork, not the generic Pi upstream, contains the cited paths.
Session ledger folding and coverage fixtures. Unknown frontier must not default to branch tip.
Rollover and note provenance. Cross-store activation requires durable source/destination receipts and fencing.
Verification/retry, path-adversarial and message-provenance fixtures. Model verification alone does not certify file/path authority or exact coverage.
Deferred context and evidence ranking. Description trimming may change actual tool behavior; do not substitute ranking for eligibility.
Request capacity, legal cuts and native recovery fixtures. Learned capacity must not exceed known hard caps; text equality is not stable source identity.
Structured brief sections help context projection; brief is not underlying evidence or a second transcript.
DAG, extraction-span provenance, search/rerank, cache coherence, belief ledger. JS string spans are not UTF-8 byte ranges; reranker cannot add candidates; cache invalidation is not live authority.

LCM schema, integrity and replacement. No second transcript, and no assumption of equivalent database transaction semantics. Canonical repository moved from voltropy/volt; voltcode historical name is not the verified clone URL.
